clips.title: The story
paras: In southeastern Ashenvale, demons hold the high ground above the place where Mannoroth fell. Lingering fel magic stains the ridge, and the Burning Legion has claimed a night elf barrow den.

Demon Fall Ridge rises west of Demon Fall Canyon, its cliffs stained by fel left from the Third War. Below, the canyon marks the clash between Grommash Hellscream and the pit lord Mannoroth. Surviving demons use the ridge as a staging ground. Lesser demons patrol the rocky heights, defiling the woodland and threatening travelers along Ashenvale's southern border.

A night elf barrow den lies abandoned in the ridge's side, its passages turned into a stronghold of dark sorcery. Fel fiends fill the halls where druids once slept. In the deepest reaches, Diathorus the Seeker, a cunning dreadlord, rules the conclave and directs the remaining demons across the forest.
